author: GamingBolt
description:
Leon Scott Kennedy, a veteran of the Resident Evil series, who's been present since its first widely publicized outbreak (resulting in Raccoon City's destruction). Throughout the decades, we've seen him as a specialist – an agent for the Division of Security Operations (the DS0), usually sent in alone, to accomplish seemingly impossible objectives. 

A man of principles, yet one who effectively sold his future to really begin his journey of combating bio-terrorism. How did it all begin? How did he go from one potentially world-ending incident to the next - from rookie police officer to a weathered veteran in Resident Evil Requiem?
title: Leon Scott Kennedy - The Complete Timeline - Before You Begin Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
GreedFall: The Dying World is an old-school influenced RPG that takes place three years before its well-received predecessor. As it’s technically a prequel, developer Spiders saw fit to drop the number two from its title during its early access phase; and, during the near-eighteen months the game’s been in early access, the studio has brought changes infinitely more sweeping than a simple name tweak. 

From revamped systems, to visual overhauls and new locations, here are fifteen things to know before you buy GreedFall: The Dying World 1.0.
title: GreedFall 2: The Dying World 1.0 Release - What's NEW?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Blending 80’s horror energy with co-operative shooting and vehicular chaos, John Carpenter’s Toxic Commando is poised to find extra mileage in a roadworn genre. 

Built by Saber Interactive and infused with Carpenter’s signature touch, the game brings zombie swarms, limitless customisations, and open mission structures, all wrapped in pulpy humour and ladles of slime. Here, we’ll rundown fifteen key things to know before you buy, covering gameplay mechanics, content plans, and an early concern.
title: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando - 15 NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
